# Rule guess: draw outline of bounding box (color2) but do not overwrite existing non-bg cells (marks stay); marks may sit ON the border.
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]

G=load()
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for rr in (r0,r1):
            if out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for cc in (c0,c1):
            if out[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=2
    return out
for k in [1,2,3]:

# Define f: for each pair of columns c1<c2 present in mark data and rows r1<r2 such that each side has >=2 marks, draw its perimeter (overwriting bg cells with 2, never touching existing marks). Verify on all 6 demos first.
def qual(fg):
    h,w=len(fg),len(fg[0]); bg=fg[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if fg[r][c]!=bg]
    V=[[1 if fg[r][c]!=bg else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    return pts,V
def f2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    pts,V=qual(g)
    R0=min(p[0] for p in pts); R1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    C0=min(p[1] for p in pts); C1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def draw(r1,r2,c1,c2):
        for c in range(c1,c2+1):
            if out[r1][c]==bg: out[r1][c]=2
        for c in range(c1,c2+1):
            if out[r2][c]==bg: out[r2][c]=2
        for r in range(r1,r2+1):
            if out[r][c1]==bg: out[r][c1]=2
        for r in range(r1,r2+1):
            if out[r][c2]==bg: out[r][c2]=2
    # outer bbox frame always; inner: any rect [r1,r2]x[c1,c2] with each side having >=2 marks and strictly inside bbox
    rects=[]
    for r1 in range(R0,R1+1):
        for r2 in range(r1+1,R1+1):
            for c1 in range(C0,C1+1):
                for c2 in range(c1+1,C1+1):
                    tm=sum(V[r1][c] for c in range(c1,c2+1))
                    bm=sum(V[r2][c] for c in range(c1,c2+1))
                    lm=sum(V[r][c1] for r in range(r1,r2+1))
                    rm=sum(V[r][c2] for r in range(r1,r2+1))
                    if tm>=2 and bm>=2 and lm>=2 and rm>=2 and not (c1==C0 and r1==R0 and r2==R1 and c2==C1):
                        rects.append((r1,r2,c1,c2))
    for s in rects: draw(*s)
    draw(R0,R1,C0,C1)
    return out
